source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Which scope best suits a skill that follows conventions specific to one project?

options.text: Personal scope with the project conventions applied everywhere
options.feedback: Personal reuse is suitable when assumptions fit the receiving projects. Applying unusual conventions everywhere ignores that condition.

options.text: Project-local scope where those conventions apply
options.feedback: A skill tied to a project's assumptions fits project-local scope. It remains reusable across tasks in that project.

options.text: Personal scope with project-specific selection guidance removed
options.feedback: Removing the guidance makes its assumptions harder to recognize. Broader availability does not make those assumptions broadly appropriate.

options.text: Project-local scope with its reusable procedure removed
options.feedback: Local placement is useful, but removing the procedure discards the reusable expertise. Location and instructions serve different purposes.
